enable_all_stats.description: Enable all statistics gathering options (-a), equivalent to -c, -f, -g, -t and -H

use_rapl.description: Read power statistics from RAPL domains (-R). Supported by recent Linux kernels and Sandybridge+ Intel processors

show_rapl_domains.description: Enable extra power stats showing all power domain readings (-D). Only applies when RAPL is enabled

show_histogram.description: Show histogram of power measurements at the end of the run (-H)

gather_c_states.description: Gather CPU C-state activity and show % time/count in each C-state at end of run (-c)

gather_cpu_freq.description: Compute geometric mean of all on-line CPU core frequencies (-f)

gather_temps.description: Gather temperatures from all available thermal zones on the device (-t)

redo_if_busy.description: Redo sample measurement if system is busy (less than 98% CPU idle) (-b)

idle_threshold.description: Specify the idle threshold (in % CPU idle) to force a re-sample if CPU is less idle than this level (-i threshold). Default 98%

redo_if_fork_exit.description: Redo sample measurement if any processes fork(), exec(), or exit() (-p)

redo_if_not_idle_and_fork.description: Redo if system is not idle AND any processes fork(), exec(), or exit() (-r). Alias for -p -b

log_fork_exit.description: Dump a log of process fork(), exec(), and exit() activity on completion (-s)

use_standard_averaging.description: Use standard averaging instead of 120-second rolling average for power consumption (-S)

ignore_zero_power.description: Forcibly ignore zero power rate readings from the battery (-z)

no_headings.description: Disable column headings to allow easy output parsing and capturing (-n)

start_delay.description: Delay in seconds before starting measurements (-d delay). Default 180s on battery, 0s with RAPL

interval.description: Measurement interval in seconds between samples (positional argument). Default 10

count.description: Number of samples to collect (positional argument). Default 10
